limitations.note: The patch left the warning outputs combinational instead of registering them from the pre-edge balance and mode, and rewrote billing to deduct a fee on recharge cycles that should only add money.
The testbench assumed both same-cycle recharge and deduction and immediate warning updates, so it passed the patch while rejecting the intended behavior.
